sections.content: The Doctors Program provides tailored financing solutions for clinic and medical center owners, including general practitioners, dentists, and specialist doctors. The program is designed to meet doctors’ financial needs through special benefits based on years of experience and medical specialization, while offering flexible financing terms and high financing limits suitable for the medical profession.

sections.section_title: Doctors Loan > Terms and Conditions > 8. Housing Loans and Car Loans
sections.content: Doctors may benefit from housing and car loan programs according to the terms and conditions of those programs, based on the approved income calculated according to years of experience and medical specialization.

content_blocks.text: Doctors may benefit from housing and car loan programs according to the terms and conditions of those programs, based on the approved income calculated according to years of experience and medical specialization.

sections.section_title: Doctors Loan > Terms and Conditions > 9. Credit Cards
sections.content: • Credit cards may be granted up to: 5 times the approved income ,Maximum limit JOD 25,000.

content_blocks.label: 9. Credit Cards
items: Credit cards may be granted up to: 5 times the approved income ,Maximum limit JOD 25,000.

sections.section_title: Doctors Loan > Terms and Conditions > 10. Credit Approval Validity
sections.content: • Credit approval remains valid for 45 days.

content_blocks.label: 10. Credit Approval Validity
items: Credit approval remains valid for 45 days.

sections.section_title: Doctors Loan > Terms and Conditions > 11. General Notes
sections.content: • If the customer meets the Doctors Program requirements, but the bank statements indicate a higher actual income than the approved program income, the profit ratios applied under the Professionals Program may be used to calculate a higher income while maintaining the financing limits and conditions of the Doctors Program.

content_blocks.label: 11. General Notes
items: If the customer meets the Doctors Program requirements, but the bank statements indicate a higher actual income than the approved program income, the profit ratios applied under the Professionals Program may be used to calculate a higher income while maintaining the financing limits and conditions of the Doctors Program.
